title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15777v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. B

translated_title: SO-Arena：基准测试系统一模型的能力光谱与可靠性
translated_abstract: 系统一模型致力于实现快速、通用的决策能力，而无需冗长的 token 生成。然而，要理解其能力光谱与决策可靠性，仅仅依赖现有基准上的总体性能是不够的。现有评估往往难以深入揭示模型能力的广度以及其决策的可靠性。我们提出了 SO-Arena，这是一个用于刻画系统一模型在 11 个领域和五大能力族中的能力光谱与决策可靠性的基准。在能力光谱方面，SO-Arena 通过可靠来源并对参考标签与模型可见输入进行人工核验，提供有据可依的评估；通过领域特定的难度标准实现细粒度的能力评估；并支持真实的交互式评估，模型可在沙箱环境中迭代执行操作。推理密集型任务进一步支持了系统一与系统二的对比分析。
tldr: 提出了 SO-Arena 基准，通过覆盖 11 个领域和五大能力族的有据可依评估、细粒度能力评估与真实交互式评估，系统性地刻画了系统一模型的能力光谱与决策可靠性。
en_tdlr: We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark that characterizes the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families through evidence-grounded, fine-grained, and realistic interactive evaluation.
